title: Dentists learn how to brush (ZÄLP): Improving manual oral hygiene in dental students
summary: A curricular learning unit including a compulsory tooth-brushing exercise as part of their assessment is being introduced in the 3rd semester of dental education. Students are expected to learn how to clean their own teeth to a near-plaque-free level. The study examines changes in their toothbrushing procedure, oral health, self-perceived oral cleanliness after brushing, and psychological factors. It also explores how students experience the learning process and what relevance they attribute to it for their future work with patients. Assessments are conducted before and after the learning unit and at least four weeks later. Seventh-semester students are additionally assessed as a reference group.
conditions: Maintaining oral health and preventing dental diseases by optimizing oral hygiene (with a focus on plaque control and gingivitis prevention).

interventions.name: Third-semester dental students complete a newly introduced curricular toothbrushing exercise with a competency assessment. Seventh-semester dental students also complete a curricular toothbrushing exercise with a competency assessment once at the beginning of the semester. The data collected serve as an additional reference for interpreting changes observed in the third-semester students.
